Action.name: ESOHYBRIDUI_MAIN_MENU_PREVIOUS_CATEGORY
Action.Down: if ESOHybridUI and ESOHybridUI:CycleKeyboardMainMenuCategory(-1) then return true end return false

Action.name: ESOHYBRIDUI_MAIN_MENU_NEXT_CATEGORY
Action.Down: if ESOHybridUI and ESOHybridUI:CycleKeyboardMainMenuCategory(1) then return true end return false

Action.name: ESOHYBRIDUI_UTILITY_WHEEL_CYCLE_LEFT
Action.Down: if ESOHybridUI and ESOHybridUI:ShouldBridgeUtilityWheelInput() then return ESOHybridUI:CycleUtilityWheel(-1) end return false

Action.name: ESOHYBRIDUI_UTILITY_WHEEL_CYCLE_RIGHT
Action.Down: if ESOHybridUI and ESOHybridUI:ShouldBridgeUtilityWheelInput() then return ESOHybridUI:CycleUtilityWheel(1) end return false
